description: Get EU legal basis for a specific provision within a Korean statute, with article-level precision. Example: PIPA Article 15 -> references GDPR Article 6 (lawful processing). Use this for pinpoint EU compliance checks at the provision level. If no provision_ref is provided, returns all EU references for the statute.

law_identifier.description: Korean statute identifier (e.g., "act-16930") or title (e.g., "개인정보 보호법")

name: get_provision_eu_basis
